paper.title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning

result.summary: 本文研究如何通过纯强化学习激励大语言模型的推理能力，而无需人工标注的推理轨迹 [abstract]。作者基于 DeepSeek-V3-Base，采用 GRPO 作为 RL 框架，仅以最终答案正确性作为奖励信号，训练出 DeepSeek-R1-Zero，并进一步通过多阶段流程（冷启动、RL、拒绝采样与 SFT、二次 RL）得到 DeepSeek-R1 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。DeepSeek-R1-Zero 在 AIME 2024 上的 pass@1 从 15.6% 提升到 77.9%，并自发涌现出反思、验证等推理行为 [S2.SS3.p2][S2.SS3.p5]。作者还蒸馏出多个小模型并公开，认为这些模型可为理解长链推理机制提供资源 [S1.p4]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：如何在不依赖大量人工标注推理轨迹的情况下，激励大语言模型发展推理能力 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。原文指出，现有 CoT 提示和基于人工标注推理轨迹的后训练方法依赖人工标注，限制可扩展性并引入认知偏差，且模型性能受限于人类示例，无法探索更优的非人类式推理路径 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: Their dependence on human-annotated reasoning traces hinders scalability and introduces cognitive biases.
by constraining models to replicate human thought processes, their performance is inherently capped by the human-provided exemplars
we aim to explore the potential of LLMs for developing reasoning abilities through self-evolution in an RL framework, with minimal reliance on human labeling efforts.

method.text: 论文提出以纯强化学习激励推理能力：基于 DeepSeek-V3-Base，采用 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 作为 RL 框架，奖励仅基于最终预测与标准答案的正确性，不约束推理过程，并跳过 RL 前的常规监督微调阶段 [S1.p2]。奖励系统由准确率奖励和格式奖励组成，不使用神经奖励模型 [S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS2.p4]。对于 DeepSeek-R1，作者采用多阶段流程：冷启动数据、RL、拒绝采样与 SFT、二次 RL，并引入语言一致性奖励和基于模型的通用奖励 [S3.p2][S3.SS2.SSS1.p1][S3.SS2.SSS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: we build upon DeepSeek-V3-Base and employ Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) as our RL framework.
The reward signal is solely based on the correctness of final predictions against ground-truth answers, without imposing constraints on the reasoning process itself.
we bypass the conventional supervised fine-tuning (SFT) phase before RL training.
Our rule-based reward system mainly consists of two types of rewards: accuracy rewards and format rewards.
we abstain from applying neural reward models—whether outcome-based or process-based—to reasoning tasks.
we develop DeepSeek-R1, whose pipeline is illustrated in Figure 2.
we introduce a language consistency reward during RL training, which is calculated as the proportion of target language words in the CoT.
For general data, we utilize reward models to guide training.

experiments.text: 论文在 MMLU、MMLU-Redux、MMLU-Pro、C-Eval、CMMLU、IFEval、FRAMES、GPQA Diamond、SimpleQA、C-SimpleQA、SWE-Bench Verified、Aider、LiveCodeBench、Codeforces、CNMO 2024 和 AIME 2024 等基准上评估模型 [S4.p1]。DeepSeek-R1-Zero 的训练设置包括学习率 3e-6、KL 系数 0.001、采样温度 1，每题采样 16 个输出，最大长度前期 32,768 tokens、后期 65,536 tokens，共训练 10,400 步 [S2.SS1.p3]。评估时最大生成长度设为 32,768 tokens，默认使用 pass@k 评估并以非零温度报告 pass@1 [A4.SS1.SSS0.Px4.p2]。

evidence.quote: We evaluate our models on MMLU, MMLU-Redux, MMLU-Pro, C-Eval, and CMMLU, IFEval, FRAMES, GPQA Diamond, SimpleQA, C-SimpleQA, SWE-Bench Verified, Aider, LiveCodeBench (2024-08 – 2025-01), Codeforces, Chinese National High School Mathematics Olympiad (CNMO 2024), and American Invitational Mathematics Examination 2024 (AIME 2024).
we set the learning rate to 3e-6, the KL coefficient to 0.001, and the sampling temperature to 1 for rollout.
we sample 16 outputs with a maximum length of 32,768 tokens before the 8.2k step and 65,536 tokens afterward.
with training continuing for a total of 10,400 steps, corresponding to 1.6 training epochs.
We set the maximum generation length to 32,768 tokens for the models.
we default to pass@ $k$ evaluation and report pass@1 using a non-zero temperature.

findings.text: DeepSeek-R1-Zero 在 AIME 2024 上的平均 pass@1 从初始 15.6% 提升到 77.9%，结合自一致性解码可达 86.7% [S2.SS3.p2]。训练中模型思考时间稳步增加，并自发出现反思性推理和替代方案探索等行为，还出现使用“wait”一词的“aha moment” [S2.SS3.p4][S2.SS3.p5]。DeepSeek-R1 的最终 RL 阶段在通用指令遵循和用户偏好基准上取得主要提升，AlpacaEval 2.0 提升 25%，ArenaHard 提升 17% [S4.p3]。蒸馏模型在数学基准上可超越非推理基线，且性能随学生模型参数量增加而逐步提升 [A6.p4]。

evidence.quote: the average pass@1 score on AIME 2024 shows a significant increase, jumping from an initial 15.6% to 77.9%.
by leveraging the self-consistency decoding, the model’s performance can be further improved, achieving an accuracy of 86.7%.
DeepSeek-R1-Zero exhibits a steady increase in thinking time throughout training, driven solely by intrinsic adaptation rather than external modifications.
DeepSeek-R1-Zero increasingly exhibits advanced reasoning strategies such as reflective reasoning and systematic exploration of alternative solutions
DeepSeek-R1-Zero exhibits an “aha moment” (Table 2), characterized by a sudden increase in the use of the word “wait” during reflections
The primary advancements in the final DeepSeek-R1 were in general instruction-following and user-preference benchmarks, with AlpacaEval 2.0 improving by 25% and ArenaHard by 17%.
the straightforward distillation of outputs from DeepSeek-R1 allows the distilled model, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, to surpass non-reasoning baselines on mathematical benchmarks.
model performance improves progressively as the parameter size of the student model increases.

limitations.text: 作者明确承认 DeepSeek-R1 存在多项能力局限：结构化输出能力仍不理想，且无法利用搜索引擎、计算器等工具提升输出表现 [S6.p3]；token 效率仍有优化空间，简单问题上仍观察到过度推理（overthinking）[S6.p4]；目前主要优化中英文，处理其他语言时可能出现语言混合 [S6.p5]；对提示敏感，few-shot 提示会持续降低其性能 [S6.p6]；由于评估耗时长影响 RL 效率，软件工程任务未大规模应用 RL，因此在该类基准上未较 DeepSeek-V3 展现巨大提升 [S6.p7]。此外，纯 RL 方法本身面临奖励黑客挑战：对于写作等难以构建可靠奖励模型的任务，若奖励由模型而非预定义规则给出，训练推进中更易被利用，因此对无法由可靠奖励模型有效评估的复杂任务，扩大纯 RL 方法仍是开放挑战 [S6.p9]。

evidence.quote: Currently, the structural output capabilities of DeepSeek-R1 remain suboptimal compared to existing models.
DeepSeek-R1 cannot leverage tools, such as search engines and calculators, to improve the performance of output.
there remains room for further optimization in terms of token efficiency, as instances of excessive reasoning—manifested as overthinking—are still observed in response to simpler questions.
DeepSeek-R1 is currently optimized for Chinese and English, which may result in language mixing issues when handling queries in other languages.
it is sensitive to prompts. Few-shot prompting consistently degrades its performance.
large-scale RL has not been applied extensively in software engineering tasks. As a result, DeepSeek-R1 has not demonstrated a huge improvement over DeepSeek-V3 on software engineering benchmarks.
If the reward signal is assigned by a model instead of predefined rules, it becomes more susceptible to exploitation as training progresses
for complex tasks that cannot be effectively evaluated by a reliable reward model, scaling up pure RL methods remains an open challenge.
